shorts.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's new decision model. Instead of writing text, it answers bounded questions your code can act on: Choice picks a route from a set of options and tells you how sure it is, Score grades a draft against your own ordered rubric, and Noul returns one number from 0 to 1 for a yes or no
